verdict.rationale: Auth0's first-party docs describe Token Vault, which obtains, stores, and refreshes access and refresh tokens so agents can call third-party APIs such as Google, Slack, and GitHub without handling credentials. The docs cite 30+ integrations and SDKs for LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, and others, all framed as delegated authorization on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the user-consent and token-exchange mechanics, specifics on short-lived token lifetimes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
